result.instructions: Tools for MailBluster, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Look up the lead customer@example.com and show their contact details."; "List the orders recorded for my shop with their totals."; "Which products have I registered for my shop's sales tracking?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MailBluster data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mailbluster_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mailbluster_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mailbluster_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. mailbluster_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mailbluster_list_fields
tools.title: List custom lead fields
tools.description: List the brand's custom lead fields: id, label and merge tag. Use the merge tags as keys of `fields` when creating or updating leads. GET /fields.

tools.name: mailbluster_create_field
tools.title: Create custom lead field
tools.description: WRITE: create a custom lead field. The merge tag is the key used in lead `fields` and in email templates. Creating a field changes the brand's data model but sends nothing. POST /fields.

tools.name: mailbluster_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: Get one lead by email address (the server computes the MD5 id MailBluster uses): name, custom fields, timezone, subscribed and opt-in status, tags, created/updated dates. MailBluster has no list-leads endpoint. GET /leads/{md5(email)}.

lead_hash.description: Alternative to email: the 32-character MD5 hex of the lowercased email.

tools.name: mailbluster_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: WRITE: add a lead (contact) to the brand. `subscribed` defaults to FALSE: the lead is stored but is not subscribed to email. Only set subscribed=true when the person has given consent to receive email from this brand (the user is responsible for lawful consent); this server never subscribes anyone on its own. No email is sent by this tool (double opt-in is not offered). If the lead already exists the call fails unless overwrite_existing=true, which replaces the stored data (then `subscribed` must be given explicitly). POST /leads.

fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's MERGE TAG (see mailbluster_list_fields), e.g. {"company": "Pied Piper"}.

ip_address.description: Lead's IP address; MailBluster derives country/city/timezone from it.

subscribed.description: Default false. true only with the lead's consent to receive email.

tags.description: Tag names to attach (created if missing).

overwrite_existing.description: Default false. true overwrites an existing lead with the same email.

tools.name: mailbluster_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing lead's name, custom fields, email, timezone, IP address, subscription flag or tags (send only what should change). `subscribed` is left alone unless you pass it; false unsubscribes the lead, true re-subscribes. Only set subscribed=true when the person has given consent to receive email from this brand (the user is responsible for lawful consent); this server never subscribes anyone on its own. PUT /leads/{md5(email)}.

email.description: Current email of the lead to update (preferred).

lead_hash.description: Alternative to email: the 32-character MD5 hex of the lowercased current email.

new_email.description: Change the lead's email address to this.

fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's MERGE TAG (see mailbluster_list_fields), e.g. {"company": "Pied Piper"}.

subscribed.description: Only pass to change the subscription. true only with the lead's consent.

add_tags.description: Tag names to attach (created if missing). Applied before remove_tags.

tools.name: mailbluster_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List product records (id, name, dates) the brand has registered for e-commerce tracking. Paged: the reply's meta has total and nextPageNo (null on the last page). GET /products.

page_no.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's meta.nextPageNo.

tools.name: mailbluster_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product record by the id you registered it under. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: mailbluster_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: WRITE: register a product record (your own id plus a name) so orders can reference it. Sends nothing to anyone and charges nothing. POST /products.

tools.name: mailbluster_update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: WRITE: rename a product record. PUT /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: mailbluster_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List order records (id, currency, total price, customer lead, campaign, line items). These are records kept in MailBluster for tracking; no payment is involved. Paged: see meta.nextPageNo. GET /orders.

page_no.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's meta.nextPageNo.

tools.name: mailbluster_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get one order record by the id it was created with. GET /orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: mailbluster_create_order
tools.title: Create order record
tools.description: WRITE: record an order (a tracking record: it does not take payment, charge a card or send email). The customer's email becomes a lead if none exists, and the lead's tags are merged. `customer.subscribed` is REQUIRED because MailBluster would otherwise default it to true: pass false unless the customer has consented to email. For a customer who already exists, the value may replace their stored subscription state. Only set subscribed=true when the person has given consent to receive email from this brand (the user is responsible for lawful consent); this server never subscribes anyone on its own. POST /orders.

fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's MERGE TAG (see mailbluster_list_fields), e.g. {"company": "Pied Piper"}.

subscribed.description: Required. true only with the customer's consent to receive email; otherwise false.

campaign_id.description: Id of the campaign that led to the order, if any.

id.description: Your id of the product (a product record with this id is created in MailBluster if it does not exist).

tools.name: mailbluster_update_order
tools.title: Update order record
tools.description: WRITE: change an order record's campaign, currency, total or items (send only what should change; `items`, when given, REPLACES all previous items). The customer cannot be changed here. No payment or email is involved. PUT /orders/{order_id}.

items.description: New complete item list; replaces the previous items.

id.description: Your id of the product (a product record with this id is created in MailBluster if it does not exist).
